key_findings.finding: The mapped transformation is a Knoevenagel-type condensation: the aldehyde of the first substrate (Cc1c(CCC(=O)O)c[nH]c1C=O) reacts with the activated methylene alpha to the lactam carbonyl in the iodinated cyclic amide (O=C1Cc2cc(I)ccc2N1). The new bond is a C–C bond from the former aldehyde carbon to the lactam C-3 carbon, followed by dehydration to give the exocyclic C=C conjugated to the 2-quinolinone carbonyl. The aryl C–I bond is retained; this is not an Ullmann, Suzuki, or other iodine-coupling reaction.
